name: Ops chain-terminal observation
description: Fires once per chain when the reviewer-qa loop completes successfully (any verdict from accept/reject/needs_clarification — these are decide actions, not loop outcomes; the loop itself always completes successfully when the reviewer submits work). Spawns one ops-chain-observer with the chain's anchor refs in agent.related_loops so ops can hydrate the full chain context (chain entity → milestone loops → step triples) and emit a coherent end-to-end diagnosis. Per-chain detail observation pattern, complementing the upstream ops-analyst sampling pattern. ADR-027 Phase 1 (read-only) + ADR-038 chain entity as fusion substrate + ADR-041 MVP role-name rename (was dev-via-spec-qa-reviewer). Chain.paused observation is NOT covered by this rule — that's a separate failure-path follow-up; chainpause already emits chain.paused.* triples that operators can read directly.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.ops-chain-observer
on_enter.prompt: The reviewer-qa loop at $entity.instance just completed. Walk this chain end-to-end per your `10-chain-walk.md` (start from the researcher loop_id in your task properties, walk agent.loop.parent up to the chain root, then read each milestone's loop_result — including the reviewer-qa's own loop for the verdict and decision_reason; sample step triples only when a specific signal warrants). Emit findings via emit_diagnosis per your `20-diagnosis-rules.md`. When done, call submit_work.

metadata.trigger: reviewer-qa loop completion (outcome=success; the decide action — accept/reject/needs_clarification — is the verdict, separate from loop outcome)
metadata.related_loops_consumers: ops-chain-observer reads both qa_reviewer (the trigger loop) and researcher (chain anchor) from agent.related_loops in its task properties. The researcher key is also the canonical chain.AnchorRoleKeys anchor for emit-tools; qa_reviewer is observer-specific and ignored by other consumers.
metadata.subject_shape_note: Subject MUST be exactly two segments after `agent.task.` (i.e. `agent.task.<role-or-id>`) — agentic-dispatch subscribes on `agent.task.*` (NATS single-token wildcard). Subjects with more segments (e.g. `agent.task.ops.chain_terminal_observe`) silently drop into the void: rule fires, action publishes, but no consumer subscribes. Smoke #8 run-11 surfaced this when the rule succeeded but ops-chain-observer never spawned.
